links.outcome: ChatGPT answer quality and patient knowledge: structured question outline vs free use
links.effect: Answer quality 92.1 ± 4.3 (outline) vs 81.4 ± 10.4 (free), P = 0.001; knowledge 95.3 ± 4.7 (outline) vs 82.1 ± 12.3 (free) vs 95.6 ± 5.3 (physician).
links.quote: With the outline given to patients, ChatGPT gave higher-quality answers compared with the answers from the group with free education (92.1 ± 4.3 versus 81.4 ± 10.4, P = 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Providing patients a printed pre-defined question outline to structure their use of a general-purpose chatbot for patient education
